subject: Pen test technical addendum & SIG/CAIQ evidence integration
messages:
From: Patrick Sullivan <patrick.sullivan@alphamed.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: ops@sentinelsec.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test addendum + SIG/CAIQ mapping (AlphaMed)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our compliance team is finalizing a SIG review and the CAIQ upload for our vendor inventory. One of the controls in SIG requires a penetration test report (or equivalent addendum) that documents: scope, lead tester, a summary of findings with CVSS or risk classifications, and a remediation statement for any findings that remain open.

We have the baseline pen test report you uploaded earlier; however, our GRC team needs a short technical addendum that maps the report to the SIG control IDs and a redacted PDF suitable for upload to our portal (link below). Can you confirm:

- Whether Redwood can provide a CAIQ appendix mapping to the report
- A proposed timeline for a redacted report + addendum to be uploaded to our GRC portal (we need it within two weeks ideally)
- If third-party pen test vendor sign-off (SentinelSec) will be included in the artifact or provided separately

GRC portal: https://grc.alphamed.com/portal/records/REDWOOD-5678

Appreciate a short plan so my team can mark this as in-progress.

Best,
Patrick
Patrick Sullivan
Senior Vendor Risk Manager, AlphaMed
patrick.sullivan@alphamed.com

Attachments referenced: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Sullivan <patrick.sullivan@alphamed.com>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test addendum + SIG/CAIQ mapping (AlphaMed)

Patrick,

Thanks — we can handle this. High-level plan:

1) Prepare a concise technical addendum (2-3 pages) that:
   - Identifies the pen test scope, test dates, and lead tester (SentinelSec)
   - Maps findings to SIG control IDs and includes a CAIQ appendix referencing the same findings
   - Provides a remediation status table (mitigated / in progress / accepted risk) with dates

2) Produce a redacted PDF suitable for your GRC upload. We'll follow the attached redaction checklist so no sensitive customer data or exploit PoC code is included.

3) Coordinate sign-off: we will request a short confirmation statement from SentinelSec (they usually provide an addendum-signoff PDF). If you prefer the vendor statement embedded in our addendum we can attempt that, otherwise provide the vendor statement as a separate attachment.

Proposed timeline:
- Confirmation of exact scope items to include: by EOD tomorrow (Aug 31)
- Draft addendum + redacted PDF: 6 business days after scope confirmation
- SentinelSec sign-off / final packaging: 2 business days after draft (so total ~8 bdays)

I'll kick this off with Mina (technical author) and loop Laura for legal/acceptance language.

Attachments: scope-confirmation.docx, redaction-checklist-v1.pdf

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ops@sentinelsec.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test addendum + SIG/CAIQ mapping (AlphaMed)

Jonas / Laura — drafting notes and what I'll include in the technical addendum below. Copying SentinelSec for visibility on the final sign-off.

Draft contents (technical):
- Executive summary (1 paragraph)
- Scope & exclusions (list of hosts, environments included and explicit exclusions: backups, partner networks)
- Test approach & dates; lead tester name and contact (SentinelSec)
- Findings summary table:
   - Finding ID, short title, CVSS (or our internal severity), short description, remediation status, remediation ETA if in progress
- CAIQ appendix: list of CAIQ question IDs mapped to evidence artifacts (e.g., pt report section, logs, config screenshots) — we will supply the appendix as a separate TSV inside the package so you can upload to your portal.
- Redaction notes: what we'll remove (raw PoC, internal IPs, customer data) — see redaction-checklist-v1.pdf attached

Questions for AlphaMed:
- For CAIQ, do you prefer the appendix as a single TSV file or as inline tables in the addendum? Either works for us but the TSV maps cleanly into most portals.
- Do you require hashed verification (SHA256) of the redacted PDF when we upload?

Attachments: pt-addendum-draft.txt (technical placeholder)

I'll aim to have a draft ready for internal review by Aug 37 (joking — sorry, Sept 7). Realistic target: Sept 9. If AlphaMed needs it faster we can compress and remove the CAIQ appendix for an initial upload.

— Mina
Senior Application Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Patrick Sullivan <patrick.sullivan@alphamed.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, ops@sentinelsec.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test addendum + SIG/CAIQ mapping (AlphaMed)

Jonas / Mina — thanks, that plan works for us. A few quick confirmations: 

- TSV for CAIQ appendix is preferred — our portal imports that directly.
- SHA256 hash for the uploaded redacted PDF would be great, please include the hash file or a short verification note in the upload.
- Vendor sign-off: SentinelSec may send their statement as a separate PDF; we accept that as long as the filename and internal reference are included in the metadata of your upload (i.e., indicate it is "SentinelSec-signoff.pdf").
- For the GRC import please use the portal record ID REDWOOD-5678; I will re-open the record and mark the task owner so the import triggers the acceptance workflow.

If anything blocks on our side we'll let you know, otherwise please proceed and tag me when the draft is ready.

Thanks,
Patrick

Attachments referenced: none
